archetypes.name: Cinematic moment
archetypes.description: One composed character or environment shot with restrained cinematic motion.
archetypes.promptGuide: one principal action, natural cinematic motion, coherent subject, deliberate camera movement

archetypes.name: Full-body performance
archetypes.description: Preserve a complete silhouette while the subject walks, dances, performs, or models an outfit.
archetypes.promptGuide: full body visible head to toe, coherent anatomy, grounded footwork, changing camera angle, no static portrait crop

archetypes.name: Dialogue beat
archetypes.description: A character-led conversational beat with space reserved for separately generated dialogue audio.
archetypes.promptGuide: natural acting beat, readable eyeline, conversational pause, coherent face and hands, no false lip sync claim

archetypes.name: Action beat
archetypes.description: A short high-energy movement with one readable action and one motivated camera move.
archetypes.promptGuide: one readable action beat, dynamic but stable camera, coherent body motion, decisive beginning and end

archetypes.name: Reaction close-up
archetypes.description: A face-led emotional beat with restrained camera motion and readable expression.
archetypes.promptGuide: one readable emotional change, coherent face and eyes, restrained camera move, natural micro-expression

archetypes.name: Suspense reveal
archetypes.description: Hold visual tension before one clear reveal for thriller, mystery, or horror beats.
archetypes.promptGuide: controlled tension, motivated slow camera movement, one legible reveal, coherent lighting and spatial continuity

archetypes.name: Creature & fantasy
archetypes.description: Reference-led motion for creatures, armor, magic, and deliberately impossible fantasy subjects.
archetypes.promptGuide: preserve the reference creature design, readable silhouette, grounded weight, one coherent magical or physical action

archetypes.name: Vehicle motion
archetypes.description: A single readable car, bike, aircraft, or spacecraft move with stable geometry.
archetypes.promptGuide: preserve vehicle geometry, grounded motion and reflections, one motivated tracking move, consistent direction of travel

archetypes.name: Transformation beat
archetypes.description: A short before-to-after visual transformation centered on one subject and one transition idea.
archetypes.promptGuide: one continuous transformation, preserve subject position and identity cues, clear before and after states, no unrelated cuts

archetypes.name: Night Out rush
archetypes.description: A kinetic party image-to-video shot designed for later multi-shot carousel assembly.
archetypes.promptGuide: wild candid party moment, full bodies in motion, playful handheld energy, colorful practical lighting, decisive cut point

archetypes.name: Stylized character
archetypes.description: Reference-led animation for anime, comic, illustrated, or deliberately non-photoreal characters.
archetypes.promptGuide: preserve the reference design language, clean silhouette, expressive pose, coherent line and color treatment

archetypes.name: World reveal
archetypes.description: Reveal an environment or location with controlled parallax and a clear visual destination.
archetypes.promptGuide: environment-led establishing reveal, controlled parallax, clear depth, one destination for the camera move

archetypes.name: Product atmosphere
archetypes.description: Generated atmosphere around an approved product reference without inventing product behavior or claims.
archetypes.promptGuide: preserve the approved product reference exactly, generated motion only for atmosphere, no invented interface or claim

archetypes.name: Rhythm cut
archetypes.description: A visually decisive short motion beat intended to cut cleanly against music in final assembly.
archetypes.promptGuide: one motion phrase with a clear accent and clean cut point, visual rhythm, no generated audio claim
